outcome: Agents can start with different values of Controller-declared private scalar state
owner_impact: Initialization can now assign a finite scalar initial value to a named Controller private-state field for an individual agent with set_agent_state(i, "state_name", value). Unspecified agents keep the Controller class default. The authoring wall validates the field against the Controller schema, and the Rust runtime independently reapplies the same heterogeneous profile on reset. This is generic heterogeneous state for roles, leaders or informed agents; it contains no Constant-Bearing-specific logic.
